tulip.also: Garden tulip cultivars (Tulipa gesneriana) and wild tulips
tulip.description: Spring bulbs with a cup-shaped flower of six tepals on a single upright stem. Garden cultivars come in nearly every colour except true blue.
look_for: Cup or goblet-shaped flower with six tepals
One flower per smooth stem
Two to four broad, bluish-green leaves at the base

ulmus_americana.also: LeafSnap30 species label; related species are not covered by this label.
ulmus_americana.description: American elm is one of the woody plants in the LeafSnap30 training data. Identification uses close-up leaf photos, not flowers, bark, or a whole-tree view.
look_for: Leaves with an uneven base and doubly toothed edges.
Photograph one leaf or a short needle-bearing twig against a plain, light background.
For compound leaves, include the leaflets and the main leaf stalk.
ulmus_americana.flowering: This model identifies leaves; flowering is not used.
